question.text: Will Safe Superintelligence (SSI) release an AI model to the public in 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as Yes if SSI releases an AI model to the public before 12:00 AM PT on January 1, 2027 according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
question.fine_print:
Any AI model which is officially a product of SSI (the company) will qualify.

"To the public" means that members of the general public are able to use the AI model for free or for a fee. A company announcement, a closed beta, or a public demo will not be sufficient on its own.

If for any reason SSI fails to release an AI model to the public as detailed above, including ceasing business operations before releasing its AI model, this question will resolve as No.

A public release qualifies notwithstanding that it may be restricted to certain countries or to users who have verified their identity in some way, provided that some members of the general public are able to access the model.

***
This question's information (resolution criteria, fine print, background info, etc) is synced with an [original identical question](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46082) which opened on 2026-10-26 17:00:00. This question will resolve based on the resolution criteria and fine print of the linked original question. However, if this question would resolve differently than the original question, then this question will be annulled. Additionally, if the original question's resolution could have been known before this question opened, then this question will be annulled.

# SSI public model release in 2026: research summary

**In short:** As of 2026-11-03 I found no sign that SSI has released a model to the public. Its own site lists no launch, and no credible news reports one.

## 1. Resolution source
No single data series decides this. The question follows Metaculus Q46082 and resolves on "credible sources" reporting a public release. The best primary sources are SSI's own pages:
- 2026-11-03: The [ssi.inc](https://ssi.inc/) homepage is unchanged. It still says "one goal and one product: a safe superintelligence" and mentions no model, API, waitlist or sign-up. [ssi.inc](https://ssi.inc/)
- 2026-11-03: The newest entry on the [Updates page](https://ssi.inc/updates) is "July 26th, 2026 - We have entered into a strategic partnership with NVIDIA that will allow us to scale our compute by 10x." Before that come Daniel Gross's departure (2025-07-03) and the $1B raise (2024-09-04). There is no release announcement. [ssi.inc/updates](https://ssi.inc/updates)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. As of 2026-11-03 SSI has not released any public model, API or product.
- 2026-10-26: A guide says that as of this date SSI had published no model, API, paper, waitlist or product. [getclerion](https://getclerion.com/resources/what-is-safe-superintelligence-ssi-and-is-it-the-same-6ad01f8ee7c635924cca9d5d)
- I found no news from November 2026 about SSI or Sutskever.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-16: FutureSearch updated its forecast page. It says the August launch predicted by Gavin Baker "passed without any confirmation," and that the 2026-08-26 report of a launch "by early next week" was also wrong. [FutureSearch](https://futuresearch.ai/safe-superintelligence-forecast/)
- 2026-08-26: Globes reported that Baker said SSI would launch its first language model "by early next week." It also cited unnamed experts saying a model was being tested privately by people close to Sutskever, and said a University of Toronto researcher claimed on X to have access. Globes did not confirm any of this. The model reportedly updates its weights as it reads documents. [Globes](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-1001553588)
- 2026-08-24: Still no model and no statement from SSI. The August claim traces back to one offhand remark by Baker on the *Invest Like the Best* podcast. Newsletters, aggregator sites and YouTube repeated it. [AIToolsReview](https://aitoolsreview.co.uk/insights/ilya-sutskever-superintelligence-model)
- Around 2026-08: Social media hype, for example the X post "SSI model release incoming!!!" [X](https://x.com/IntuitMachine/status/2084699650649456931); [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/ssi-superintelligence-model-august-release/); [StartupHub](https://www.startuphub.ai/ai-news/ai-figures/2026/figure-ilya-sutskever-ssi-first-model-2026-08-14)
- 2026-07-27: SSI and NVIDIA announced a long-term partnership giving SSI access to Vera Rubin systems and about 10x more compute. Press reports put NVIDIA's investment at about $5B, but neither company disclosed the amount. [NVIDIA](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/ilya-sutskevers-safe-superintelligence-inc-and-nvidia-announce-long-term-strategic-partnership); [Calcalist](https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/qy9eg5jw4)
- Funding and size: reported totals are about $7-8B raised at roughly a $32B valuation (April 2025 round), with 20 to 50 staff depending on the source. [PitchBook](https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/606742-48); [AI Magazine](https://aimagazine.com/news/safe-superintelligence-sutskever-nvidia-and-a-us-32bn-ai-b)

## 4. Base rates
- SSI was founded in June 2024 and has shipped no public model in about 29 months. That is zero releases across roughly 9 quarters. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Safe_Superintelligence_Inc.)
- Its stated "straight-shot" strategy is to avoid product cycles. In November 2025 Sutskever softened this, saying SSI "might" release something before superintelligence and that any release would be "gradual." [Dwarkesh](https://www.dwarkesh.com/p/ilya-sutskever-2)
- The two rumored release windows in 2026 (August, and "early next week" after August 26) both passed without a release.
- About 8 weeks remain before resolution. A "gradual release" would probably start as a closed beta or limited access, which the fine print says does not count.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "SSI public model released by…?", as of 2026-11-03 18:01 UTC:
  - Nov 30: 0.8% Yes
  - Dec 31: 20% Yes
  - Aug, Sep and Oct contracts: resolved No
  - The Dec 31 contract matches this question's deadline closely, but I could not load the page to check its resolution rules or trading volume.
- FutureSearch, 2026-10-16: 8% that SSI publicly releases or announces anything in 2026, down from 38% in August. Its criteria are looser than this question's, since an announcement alone would count there. [FutureSearch](https://futuresearch.ai/safe-superintelligence-forecast/)
- Manifold, 2026-08-05: 82% that SSI ships a product before anyone builds ASI. This is a different, longer-horizon question, and I could not find current odds. [Tech-Insider](https://tech-insider.org/?p=13502)
- I found no Kalshi market on SSI. The Kalshi prices supplied with the question are about other labs.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- No SSI event, launch date or conference talk is scheduled that I could find.
- Things to watch:
  - SSI's Updates page and X account
  - Any Sutskever interview
  - New investor remarks, like Baker's
  - Signs of a paid API or a public chat interface (a waitlist or closed beta would not count)
- Compute from the NVIDIA Vera Rubin deal (July 2026) could support a new training run, but no timeline has been given publicly.
- Reliability caution: many SSI articles are low-quality SEO or aggregator pages that repeat the same Baker rumor, so they shouldn't be read as independent confirmation.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 8 weeks remain, until 12:00 AM PT on January 1, 2027. For Yes, SSI must make an AI model usable by members of the general public, free or paid, through an API, a chat interface or downloadable weights, and credible sources must report it. An announcement, closed beta, waitlist or demo does not count.

(b) Status quo: No. As of 2026-11-03, SSI has released no model, API or product. Its site still describes "one product: a safe superintelligence," and its last update is the NVIDIA deal of July 26, 2026.

(c) Base rate: SSI has made zero public releases in about 29 months, roughly 9 quarters. That puts a naive rate for any given 2-month window in the low single digits. Its "straight-shot" lab design and Sutskever's emphasis on a "gradual release" make an open public launch especially unlikely. Starting point: about 3-5%.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - On 2026-07-27, the NVIDIA partnership gave SSI about 10x compute and a reported ~$5B investment.
  - On 2026-08-26, Globes reported claims that a continual-learning model was being tested privately, with a Toronto researcher claiming access.
  - In November 2025, Sutskever said SSI "might" release something before superintelligence.
  - Polymarket's December 31 contract sits at 20%.
- **For No:**
  - The rumored August release and the "early next week" release both failed to happen.
  - FutureSearch lowered its forecast to 8% on 2026-10-16, and its criteria are looser than this question's, since an announcement alone would count.
  - Polymarket prices a release by November 30 at only 0.8%. That implies an odd ~19% chance for December alone, which suggests a thin or noisy market.
  - No events or launch signals are scheduled.
  - Any "gradual release" would likely begin as a closed beta, which does not count.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** SSI keeps training on its new compute, stays quiet or runs only private testing, and 2026 ends with no public access.
- **Yes:** In December, SSI unexpectedly opens a paid API or public chat for an early continual-learning model, possibly limited by country or identity verification, and it is reported widely.

(f) I start from a base rate of about 4%. I move up modestly for the private-testing reports, the new compute and the Polymarket price. I give the 20% Polymarket figure limited weight. It conflicts with the 0.8% November price, I could not verify its volume or rules, and FutureSearch's 8% applies to a looser standard. I end at about 6%.

Probability: 6%
